# Hook Version Drift Detection

## Context

When a new `entire` CLI release ships breaking changes to an agent's hook contract (command shape, arg order, new lifecycle hook, new permissions rule), existing installations keep running stale hooks silently. Today, only Cursor/Copilot configs carry a `version: 1` field — dead, unchecked. Other agents (Claude Code, Gemini, Factory, OpenCode) have no version marker at all. Drift is invisible until a user hits a cryptic runtime failure, and the only remediation path (`entire enable --force`) is undocumented for this purpose.

Goal: stamp each agent's hook config with the CLI version that generated it, carry a per-agent "minimum compatible" version constant in the CLI binary, and warn the user at known check points when their installed hooks fall below that floor. Remediation stays on existing `entire enable --force` — no new command.

## Design

**Stamp at install.** On `InstallHooks`, write a top-level `entireMeta` object into each agent's config:

```json
{
  "entireMeta": { "cli_version": "0.5.3" },
  "hooks": { ... }
}
```

OpenCode TS plugin: embed as a header comment line `// entireMeta: {"cli_version":"0.5.3"}` that the plugin ignores but the CLI parses on read.

**Compatibility floor per agent.** Each agent's `hooks.go` declares:

```go
// Bump when hook contract changes in a breaking way.
const MinCompatibleCLIVersion = "0.5.3"
```

Default to current `versioninfo.Version` at introduction. Only bump when a real hook contract break lands for that agent — not on every release.

**Drift check.** New helper `CheckHookDrift(ctx) ([]DriftReport, error)` in `cmd/entire/cli/agent/` iterates every enabled agent, reads its config, extracts `entireMeta.cli_version`, compares against the agent's `MinCompatibleCLIVersion`. Semver compare via `golang.org/x/mod/semver` (already a likely transitive dep — confirm during impl; otherwise use a small internal cmp). Missing stamp is treated as drift.

**Check points** (per user's selection):
- `entire status` — renders a "Hooks: stale for <agents>" line when drift detected.
- `entire enable` / session start — warn in stderr, suggest `entire enable --force`.

Explicitly out of scope: UserPromptSubmit hook fire, every-hook-fire checks, auto-apply, new `upgrade-hooks` command.

## Files to modify

- `cmd/entire/cli/versioninfo/versioninfo.go` — no change; `Version` already exported.
- `cmd/entire/cli/agent/hook_command.go` — add `HookMeta` struct, `ParseEntireMeta(configBytes) (HookMeta, error)`, `WriteEntireMetaJSON(config map[string]any)` helper that sets `entireMeta.cli_version = versioninfo.Version`. Single source of truth for both JSON and TS-comment parsers.
- `cmd/entire/cli/agent/{claudecode,cursor,copilotcli,geminicli,factoryaidroid}/hooks.go` — in each `InstallHooks`, inject `entireMeta` into the JSON map before writing. Add `MinCompatibleCLIVersion` const and `ReadHookMeta(ctx) (HookMeta, error)` method.
- `cmd/entire/cli/agent/opencode/hooks.go` + `entire_plugin.ts` template — add `// entireMeta: {"cli_version":"X"}` as the second header comment line; `ReadHookMeta` regex-extracts it.
- `cmd/entire/cli/agent/drift.go` (new) — `CheckHookDrift(ctx)` iterates agents, builds `[]DriftReport{Agent, Installed, Required, Missing}`. Reuse `GetAgentsWithHooksInstalled` from `config.go:86`.
- `cmd/entire/cli/status.go` — extend `formatSettingsStatusShort` (~line 148) or add new section after settings block; call `CheckHookDrift`, render compact line.
- `cmd/entire/cli/setup.go` — in `runManageAgents` (line 283), before the confirmation phase, call `CheckHookDrift` and print a yellow warning with the suggested `entire enable --force` invocation. On session start (hook handler), same warning emitted once per session.
- Each agent's `*_test.go` — round-trip test: install → read meta → assert `cli_version` matches `versioninfo.Version`; drift test with a backdated stamp.

## Reused utilities

- `cmd/entire/cli/agent/config.go:86` `GetAgentsWithHooksInstalled(ctx)` — iterate only agents that actually have hooks to check.
- `cmd/entire/cli/agent/hook_command.go` `IsManagedHookCommand` — unchanged; drift is a separate signal.
- `cmd/entire/cli/versioninfo.Version` — stamp source.
- `cmd/entire/cli/logging` — `Warn(ctx, ...)` for stderr warnings at session start.

## Semver edge cases

- Local dev builds set `Version = "dev"` — treat as "newest", never drift-warn. Gate via `if versioninfo.Version == "dev" { return nil }` in `CheckHookDrift`.
- Missing `entireMeta` in existing installs — report as drift with `Installed: "<none>"`, prompts user to re-run enable once to stamp.
- Pre-release suffixes (`0.5.3-rc.1`) — `semver.Compare` handles correctly as long as versions are `v`-prefixed or normalized; normalize before compare.

## Verification

1. `mise run test` — new unit tests pass for each agent's install/read-meta round trip and drift comparison.
2. `mise run test:integration` — integration test: install hooks at version X, rewrite binary version constant to Y (Y > X and Y > MinCompat), assert `entire status` shows no drift; bump MinCompat past X, assert drift reported.
3. Manual: `entire enable --agent claude-code` in fixture repo, inspect `.claude/settings.json` for `entireMeta.cli_version`. Edit to stale value, run `entire status`, confirm warning. Run `entire enable --force`, confirm re-stamp.
4. `mise run test:e2e:canary` — Vogon agent flow unchanged; drift check short-circuits for non-installed agents.
5. `mise run check` before commit.

## Open questions

- None blocking. `MinCompatibleCLIVersion` seeded to current `versioninfo.Version` at merge so no existing installs trip drift on upgrade.

## Summary

- Stamp every agent hook config (`.claude/settings.json`, `.cursor/hooks.json`, `.codex/hooks.json`, `.github/hooks/entire.json`, `.gemini/settings.json`, `.factory/settings.json`, `.opencode/plugins/entire.ts`) with a top-level `entireMeta.cli_version` on `entire enable`.
- New \`agent.CheckHookDrift\` compares installed stamp vs a single global \`agent.MinCompatibleCLIVersion\` floor.
- \`entire status\` renders a yellow \"Hooks · stale for <agents>\" line; \`entire enable\` prints the same warning before its prompts. Remediation is the existing \`entire enable --force\`.
- Floor seeded at \`\"0.0.0\"\` — no drift warnings fire today. Bump the single constant in \`cmd/entire/cli/agent/hook_command.go\` when a future release breaks a hook contract; all older installs will see one warning and re-run \`entire enable --force\`.

## Why

When a CLI release needs to modify hook wiring, existing users keep running stale hooks silently until something fails cryptically. The only remediation (\`entire enable --force\`) was undocumented for this purpose, and nothing told users they needed it. This gives us a one-line floor bump + automatic warning path for every future hook contract break.

## Design notes

- Single \`HookVersionSupport\` interface method (\`ReadHookMeta(ctx)\`) — the compatibility floor is a package-level const, not per-agent, keeping the mechanism boring.
- JSON agents stamp via \`agent.WriteJSONHookMeta(map)\`; OpenCode's TS plugin embeds a \`// entireMeta: {...}\` comment via a template placeholder.
- Stamp is backfilled on any \`entire enable\` — users on pre-stamp installs acquire an \`entireMeta\` field the next time they enable (even a no-op enable).
- Dev builds (\`versioninfo.Version == \"dev\"\`) short-circuit drift entirely.
- Vogon (test agent) skipped by design — \`AreHooksInstalled\` returns false.
